svg.aria-label: Detailed sending process with explicit platform and certificate choices
svg.title: Prepare and send invoices; track each action
svg.desc: Customer selects the sender platform, indicates the recipient platform and chooses an eligible certificate where required. The ERP request carries those choices. Step 05 checks the selected connection and qualified delivery path. Preparation binds the platform pair and certificate version. Existing correction, holds and separate action outcomes remain. Logical responsibilities and implementation support remain unqualified.
